adjudicated.why: The section is still the exemption from the section 4071 tire tax, and its heading is back to 'Exemptions', which it had before 1984. The 2004 AJCA (P.L. 108-357 §869(c)) rewrote the text in general: the exemption for extruded tiring with an internal wire fastening agent is gone, and the section now exempts tires sold for the exclusive use of DoD or the Coast Guard. Same subject area, but a 1997 citation now reaches a different exemption rule.

classifier_2.why: 1997: exemption for tires with internal wire fastening (eliminated in the 2004 tire-tax rewrite). 2025: exemption for tires sold to the Defense Department or Coast Guard. Different rule.

adjudicated.why: The 1997 Code had two sections numbered 6039F. HIPAA 1996 added the expatriate information statement, and the SBJPA 1996 added the notice of large foreign gifts. The 1997 heading compared here is the expatriate section, which was later redesignated 6039G (still an expatriate statement in 2025). A citation to that 1997 section now reaches the foreign-gift reporting rules, a different subject, not a reorganization of the same rules. The foreign-gift 6039F itself is essentially unchanged.

classifier_1.why: Expatriate information moved to 6039G; 6039F now holds the large foreign gifts notice.

classifier_2.why: In 1997 two sections carried the number 6039F: expatriate information (HIPAA 1996) and foreign gifts (SBJPA 1996). The expatriate section was redesignated 6039G, so a 1997 citation to the expatriate 6039F now reaches the foreign-gift reporting rules.

classifier_1.why: Tax shelter registration replaced by material-advisor reportable-transaction disclosure (AJCA 2004); same area, different rules.

classifier_2.why: Same area (tax-shelter reporting by promoters). AJCA 2004 replaced tax-shelter registration with material-advisor disclosure of reportable transactions, so the old subsection structure (registration, tax shelter definition) now reaches different rules.

classifier_1.why: Investor-list rule for shelter organizers replaced by advisee-list rule for material advisors (AJCA 2004).

classifier_2.why: Same area (list maintenance for tax-shelter promoters). AJCA 2004 rewrote it for material advisors of reportable transactions. Old (b), the potentially-abusive-shelter definition, now holds different rules.

classifier_1.why: Cross reference replaced by prison information-reporting requirement (2011).

classifier_2.why: 1997: cross reference to 4102 records on gasoline and lubricating oils. 2025: prisons must report inmate information to the IRS (2011).

adjudicated.why: Same subject area: partnership-level audit procedure in chapter 63, subchapter C. The BBA 2015 (P.L. 114-74 §1101) replaced the TEFRA subchapter wholesale. The TEFRA rule on the Secretary's notice to partners is gone (the notice rules are now in 6231), and 6223 now holds the partnership representative and the rule that partners are bound. A 1997 citation reaches different rules inside the same regime area.

classifier_1.why: TEFRA partnership audit rules replaced by BBA 2015 centralized regime; old notice-to-partners rule became 'partners bound'.

classifier_2.why: 1997 TEFRA: Secretary's notice to partners. 2025 BBA: partnership representative, and partners bound by partnership actions.

adjudicated.why: Still the partnership audit subchapter after the BBA wholesale substitution. In 1997 it barred assessment until the partnership-level proceedings were complete; in 2025 it covers the partnership adjustment and the imputed underpayment computation (the assessment restriction is now in 6232). Same area, reorganized rules.

classifier_1.why: TEFRA assessment-timing rule replaced by the BBA imputed underpayment/partnership adjustment.

classifier_2.why: 1997 TEFRA: restriction on assessment until partnership proceedings finish. 2025 BBA: partnership adjustment and computation of the imputed underpayment.

adjudicated.why: Same partnership-audit subchapter. The TEFRA rule for judicial review of an FPAA (by the TMP or a notice partner) moved in substance to BBA 6234. 6226 now holds the push-out election, an alternative to the partnership paying the imputed underpayment. A citation still lands in the partnership audit area but reaches different rules.

classifier_1.why: TEFRA judicial review of FPAA replaced by BBA push-out election; judicial review now at 6234.

classifier_2.why: 1997 TEFRA: judicial review of an FPAA by the tax matters partner. 2025 BBA: push-out election as an alternative to the partnership paying the imputed underpayment.

adjudicated.why: The TEFRA definitions and special rules (partnership item, TMP, notice partner, and so on) were displaced by the BBA; the BBA definitions are now in 6241. 6231 now covers notice of proceedings and of adjustments. classifier_2.why: 1997 TEFRA: definitions and special rules (the 'partnership item' definitions). 2025 BBA: notice of proceedings and adjustments. The definitions moved to 6241.
